title: 砂山 (Sunayama — Sand Dune)
description: A haunting 1922 children's song inspired by the desolate sand dunes of Yoriihama beach in Niigata, looking out across the rough sea toward Sado Island. Sparrows scatter as night falls and stars appear. The wind rises again, everyone disperses, and one by one things disappear until the singer must say goodbye to the sparrows, the dunes, and the sea itself. One of lyricist Kitahara Hakushu's most beloved works.
